subject: Film & Cinema
title: Alice Guy-Blaché: Cinema's Forgotten Pioneer
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Alice Guy-Blaché: Cinema's Forgotten Pioneer.

hook.text: She directed over 1,000 films starting in 1896. History nearly erased her completely.

buildup.text: Alice Guy-Blaché was one of the first people to direct a narrative fiction film.

discovery.text: She ran her own studio, Solax, and supervised hundreds of productions in early Hollywood.

twist.text: Male film historians credited her work to others for decades. Recognition came too late.

climax.text: Recent scholarship has restored her rightful place as one of cinema's founding figures.

punchline.text: Cinema's first great director was a woman.

quiz.question: Why was Alice Guy-Blaché largely forgotten?
options: Male historians credited her work to others for decades
